FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF ZOOLOGY, PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
No.: ZOO/24/1448 Date: 02.08.2024
ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE FOR THE POST OF GUEST FACULTY (01)
Applications are invited for appointment of Guest faculty (01) in the Department of Zoology,
P.U., Chandigarh, for odd semester of the academic session 2024-2025.
Essential Qualifications:
(i) M.Sc. in Zoology from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited
foreign University with good academic record as defined by the concerned University with at
least 55% of the marks (50% in case of SC/ST/OBC/ Physically & Visually handicapped) or
an equivalent grade in a point wherever grading system is followed at Master’s degree level.
(ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR.
(iii) The candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the
University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph.D.
Degree) Regulations, 2009, shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum
eligibility condition of NET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or
equivalent positions in Universities/ Colleges/ Institutions.
Honorarium:
The appointment of Guest Faculty is on lecture basis with token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidates shall have to give an
undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from
any agency and will do the same till that are teaching in the Department of Zoology, P.U.,
Chandigarh.
Instructions for applicants:
 The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at P.U. website
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf?112707461024
 The applications supported by relevant testimonials must reach the office of
Department of Zoology, P.U., Chandigarh by Friday, 09.08.2024 till 5:00 p.m by
hand or through post.
 The interview for the post will be held in the office of the Chairperson, Department of
Zoology, Panjab University, Chandigarh. The date and time of the interview will be
intimated to the shortlisted candidates by e-mail. The applicants are advised to bring
their original certificates and other relevant documents for verification at the time of
interview.
 No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
Sd/-
(Prof. Y.K. Rawal)
Chairman
Department of Zoology
Panjab University
Chandigarh.
